verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants read, summarize, draft and send email, check read status, schedule meetings and work across multiple Gmail/Outlook accounts. That is a real first-party programmatic surface, but it covers only a subset of the UI, and every send needs explicit approval. Probes found no OpenAPI/REST spec and no llms.txt. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API, evidence of parity for UI features (Auto Labels/split inbox config, Snippets, Auto Archive, team comments, calendar settings), an API reference/spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
